Neither of v34handshak's is inside the retrain's dynamic extent (the retrain ends in v34handshakinit, a different symbol, which does not touch the byte), so the ONLY store to +0xac00 between the two statements is the retrain's own `if (status == 2) obj[0xac00] = 1` -- the same value this one writes.  Held fixed: nothing, which is the point; the two orders cannot be told apart by any caller.
